description: This file defines extension methods for handling Azure Storage exceptions, specifically extending RequestFailedException with methods to check for various common error conditions such as not found, conflict, and precondition failed.

classes.name: StorageExceptionExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for Azure RequestFailedException to identify specific error statuses related to Azure Blob Storage.

methods.name: IsNotFound
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates a 'not found' error (HTTP 404).

methods.name: IsPreconditionFailed
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates a 'precondition failed' error (HTTP 412).

methods.name: IsConflict
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates a conflict error (HTTP 409).

methods.name: IsContainerNotFound
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates that a container was not found, by matching status and error code.

methods.name: IsBlobNotFound
methods.description: Checks if the exception indicates that a blob was not found, by matching status and error code.
